name: riders-united
description: Real-time group motorcycle convoy GPS tracking and PTT voice comms platform for Android, iOS and Web in Landscape Cockpit mode

scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "cd backend && npm start" "cd frontend && npm run preview"
scripts.cap:sync: cd frontend && npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:open:android: cd frontend && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:open:ios: cd frontend && npx cap open ios
scripts.build:apk: cd frontend && npm run build && npx cap sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
